mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.5% indicates persistent inflationary pressure, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal a dual shock of monetary tightening and economic weakness, which triggers a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts below 1300 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand and reduced economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when HOUST < 1300, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production indicates robust manufacturing activity and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate below 3.5% indicates a tight labor market that supports strong consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and industrial production signal a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST < 1300 and INDPRO < 102.0, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment increase exceeding 200,000 jobs signals strong labor market health and rising consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS > 200000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
